mapper.update: UPDATE notification SET isRead = TRUE WHERE memberId = #{memberId} AND isRead = FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE memberId = #{memberId} AND isRead = FALSE
SELECT id, memberId, type, message, isRead, regDate FROM notification WHERE memberId = #{memberId} ORDER BY regDate DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification (memberId, type, message, isRead, regDate) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{type}, #{message}, #{isRead}, NOW())
